image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cucumber plant growing in dark soil. The image features multiple cucumbers at various stages of growth: one large, mature, elongated cucumber with a bumpy texture; one medium-sized, rounder cucumber; and two smaller, younger cucumbers. Large, broad green leaves with visible veins surround the fruit, along with thin green tendrils and stems connecting the plant parts.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and blending at the boundaries between the foreground leaves and the background soil/other leaves. Some leaf margins lack crisp definition, suggesting minor generative blur or edge bleeding.

The thin green tendrils and stems show ambiguous connectivity. Some tendrils appear to float or merge into the background foliage without a clear anchor point, a common AI artifact in complex botanical structures.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'structural_collapse' severity rating for the tendrils.
